A method to unlock GTA 6 frame rates on Xbox Series X|S:

- Go to Settings → General TV & display options → Refresh rate → 60 Hz
- Start the game and wait for the 6 stars appear in the intro
- Go back to settings and change the refresh rate to 120 Hz
- Start a different game using the Xbox Guide (Xbox button) without closing GTA 6
